title: Dinner Lady Strawberry Macaroon E-Liquid 10ml
description: The Dinner Lady Strawberry Macaroon 10ml E-Liquid is a decadent treat for any sweet-toothed vaper. When you add this sweet E-Liquid to your vape device you will be able to indulge in a scrumptiously sweet and juicy puff with every draw you take. Fr eshly picked strawberries have been used to create a decadent Strawberry Macaroon flavour that’s bound to surprise and delight your taste buds. Go ahead, add some Parisian pleasure to your daily vape with Dinner Lady’s sensationally delicious Strawberry Macaroon! The 70% Vegetable Glycerine, and 30% Propylene Glycol formula make this E-Liquid ideal for sub-ohm vaping, producing mighty clouds on top of fantastic flavour and a smooth, comfortable, throat hit. Sub-ohm vaping generally requires the use of high-powered vape kits, including pod vape kits and pod mods with higher power outputs, some pen vape kits and advanced kits . If you love this Strawberry Macaroon Sub Ohm E-Liquid 10ml then why not check out more of Dinner Lady’s delicious E-Liquids? Their collection of E - L iquids covers a wide variety of flavours from fruit, menthol, fizzy drinks and more. So why not treat yourself to the sweet Dinner Lady Moments Peach Bubble 50ml Shortfill E-liquid . Or take a moment to relax with the Dinner Lady Moments Razz Blues 50ml Shortfill E-liquid.
